blocking_findings.detail: _verify_exact_function verifies the V8 reviewed loader, V8 configurer, and nested V7-V3 loader object/globals/metadata identity but does not bind their __code__, defaults, keyword defaults, or equivalent immutable callable fingerprint. The independent probe changed the existing canonical V7 loader object's __code__ before validation; object identity still matched and V9 accepted an arbitrary substituted effective turn. A second probe changed the existing canonical V8 configurer object's __code__; identity still matched and configure_retained_runner_v9 accepted and executed the substituted configuration code.
blocking_findings.impact: The claimed exact closed compatibility/configuration boundary can be pre-poisoned without changing any checked function object identity. A future live run could validate or configure a different effective plan while appearing to use the canonical bound objects.
blocking_findings.required_repair: An append-only successor must bind immutable code/default/keyword-default/closure identities for every callable executed through the compatibility and retained-configuration chain, reject any pre-call or in-call drift, and independently test both loader-result and configurer substitution.

blocking_findings.detail: The inherited deterministic semantic gate returned passed=true with an empty issue list for seventeen meaning-equivalent contradictions covering consent, exact-participant reconstruction privacy, unfinished-body/current implementation, static-render body completion, pregnancy/parenting separation, STI appearance, partner-controlled contraception, stale Elation continuity, physiological response as agreement/desire, required climax, log-to-lived-memory certainty, unbroken private sentience, nonadult full-curriculum access, spouse-contingent adult curriculum, unsafe medical diagnosis without current guidance, and related curriculum boundaries.
blocking_findings.impact: A technically complete unattended run can synthesize and physically play replies that contradict the sealed consent/privacy/body/health/currentness curriculum before later manual review. The predecessor's statement that these semantic controls are retained is therefore insufficient for one bounded live authority.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Preserve V9 and repair append-only with turn-specific contradiction gates and hostile paraphrase coverage for every exact semantic boundary, while retaining the rule that technical success is never automatic Turing, psychology, hearing, memory, body, or lived-experience acceptance.
